caption: The drawing displays three ornate metal door latches, each featuring intricate designs and symmetrical patterns. The objects are rendered in shades of brown and dark gray, evoking the appearance of aged iron or metalwork. Each latch is centrally positioned on a plain, light beige background with no additional decorative elements or shading. The top left latch has a scrollwork design with curved and leaf-like motifs extending vertically above and below a rectangular horizontal bar in the center. The top right latch also features a geometric and scrollwork pattern, with angular details connected by circular ends, centered around a similar rectangular mechanism. The bottom center latch is the largest and most ornate, with a combination of open, cut-out shapes and leaf-like decorations at both the top and bottom, framing a circular central lock component and rectangular bar. All three objects are vertically aligned, with the two smaller ones at the top left and right, and the largest centrally below them.
title: Latches
